"It was almost the same, only in this one I had a lost look," Carlos revealed that although NLP (natural-language processing) models are capable of incredible feats, their abilities are very much limited by the amount of context they receive. This difficulty could cause problems for researchers who hope to use them to do things such as analyze ancient languages. In some cases, there are not even complete texts to provide context.

Sarah Waters' novel "Fingersmith" also plays with the concept of time, as she jumps back and forth between different periods in the past. To signify this shift, Waters often employs the first line of the novel to indicate where she begins, circularly cycling the story. Even the novel's language bridges this divide. Waters often uses the word "queer" to describe the unusual or remarkable, instead of its post-1922 derogatory connotations.
